description: Get daily price candles for ONE forex currency pair (EUR/USD), newest first: open, high, low, close in the second currency, volume in the first and trades. A day runs midnight to midnight UTC, weekends included; a day without trades has no candle. History goes back to the pair's first trade on the exchange (EUR/USD: 2020). Rates are one exchange's trades, not an interbank or official reference rate, and a day's high or low can hold a stray trade. Plus and Pro also get the day in progress; Free gets a day 4 hours after it ends. GetForexQuote has the latest rate, GetForexIntradayPrices candles within the day, ListForexPairs the pairs.

endDate.description: Last UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

maxResults.description: Maximum days to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

pair.description: Currency pair, e.g. EUR/USD; EURUSD and EUR-USD also work

startDate.description: First UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the pair's first trade)

name: GetForexPrices
title: Forex Daily Prices
